tools.description: Resolve an address-like query into geographic candidates.

tools.name: place_search
tools.description: Search cities, points of interest and named places, optionally biased around a coordinate.

tools.name: mobility_nearby
tools.description: Find nearby shared bicycles, stations, scooters, mopeds, cars or taxis.

tools.name: transit_nearby
tools.description: Find nearby transit stations using the canonical ROOTE transit taxonomy.

tools.name: transit_disruptions
tools.description: Current provider alert observations for an explicit geographic network sample. Never infer normal circulation from empty alerts. Unresolved line, stop, mode or non-current time returns unavailable. Preserve partial coverage and unknown source freshness.

tools.name: services_nearby
tools.description: Find supported urban services within 1500 metres of a coordinate in one aggregated request. Types include toilets, fountains, Wi-Fi, AEDs, parking and charging.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "nearby" is 603 chars, far longer than this server's median (81). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "nearby" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Run the global ROOTE nearby orchestrator.
